conventions.convention: Use signature (−,+,+,+), future unit observer fields with g(u,u)=−1, and SI length coordinates x⁰=ct_phys. An observer congruence, adapted chart and tetrad field are distinct objects.
The geometric entropy current has components J K⁻¹ m⁻³; cS is physical flux, and c∇ₐSᵃ is production per physical volume per second.
Tξ=NξT is a field; TK denotes its value only when constancy is separately established. Mechanical, energy-valued and wave covectors pair with ξ using factors c, 1 and ℏc respectively.
The parcel marker amount is a positive real continuum variable, V>0, S is real, and (V/Np,S/Np) must belong to the supplied open state domain. Energy includes rest energy.
Slice entropy is the signed future-normal charge ∫−g(S,n)dVh. Side flux is net outward flux, and zero net side flux is sufficient for the endpoint entropy inequality.
Entropy-impermeability means pointwise vanishing of the pulled-back current flux three-form on every side face; this implies zero net side flux.

The KMS definition requires bounded continuous strip functions, analytic in the interior, for every observable pair. Physical-time width is ℏβK; length-parameter width is cℏβK. No KMS-state existence or identification with finite matter charge is asserted.

load_bearing.statement: Defines Lorentzian observer/current conventions, SI length-coordinate units, Killing normalization, distinct covector energy pairings, the bounded all-observable KMS strip condition, and the pullback-connection convention for null-hypersurface generators.
For a separately specified material/current model in its declared smooth regime, adopt ∇ₐSᵃ≥0 for its supplied C¹ entropy current throughout the open region.

Under the stated finite spacelike-cap slab hypotheses and adopted Π=∇ₐSᵃ≥0, conditional on the exact draft mathematical balance supplier, QS(x⁰₊)−QS(x⁰₋)+ΦS(B)=∫K Π vol_g≥0. Zero net outward side flux implies QS(x⁰₊)≥QS(x⁰₋).
For the selected fixed-composition branch, adopt e∈C²(D,ℝ), T=∂σp e>0, and the parcel assignment E=Np e(V/Np,S/Np) on the stated admissible parcel domain, including rest energy.

published_dependencies.used_for: Published definition of the smooth Lorentzian four-manifold, signature, time orientation, causal directions and inherited countable-choice convention.
Published existence and uniqueness of the torsion-free metric-compatible connection and its induced tensor derivative.
Published definition of a Killing field by vanishing metric Lie derivative.
Draft external supplier defining observer rest spaces, state maps, marker normalization, current types and units; its draft status is retained.
Draft external supplier specifying compact-closure rectangular slabs, spacelike caps, future normal charge, flux three-form and outward coordinate-face flux.
Draft external supplier of the exact finite current balance. Its statement and coordinate FTC/Fubini proof were inspected; the assigned physics theorem explicitly retains conditional reliance.
Draft external supplier of finite Killing matter charge, its conditional boundary balance, static expression, positive generator rescaling and covector unit distinctions.
Published local affine-Minkowski flow-box and rest-distribution result; checked the chart/congruence distinction and absence of a global foliation conclusion.
Published definition of the connection on the pulled-back ambient tangent bundle, allowing vector fields along the null hypersurface without choosing ambient extensions.
Published frame independence and pulled-back-section derivative identity used to compare intrinsic along-hypersurface differentiation with an ambient extension.

concerns.concern: The Romatschke reference names “New Developments in Relativistic Viscous Hydrodynamics” but links https://arxiv.org/pdf/0906.4787. The linked v2 title page instead reads “Relativistic Viscous Fluid Dynamics and Non-Equilibrium Entropy.” Its §4.1 does contain the cited divergence condition and experimental-verification qualification, so the substantive use is supported. The same bibliographic mismatch occurs in pthm-tgr-finite-entropy-balance and texp-tgr-insulated-entropy-region.

seams_checked.note: State-function, real-marker, observer-rest-space and current-unit uses agree with the supplied definitions; physical constitutive adoption remains separate.
Preserves finite matter-charge scope, positive Killing normalization, distinct energy pairings and conditional finite-slab balance.
Perfect-fluid adoption and local first-law uses retain the C² state function, positive temperature, rest energy and admissible continuum parcel domain.
Dissipative branches specify their own currents and closures; admissibility and physical-production units match the supplier.
Supported-rest and radiation branches use the length-coordinate and unit-observer conventions while adding their own material assumptions.
Stationary equilibrium and exchange assumptions are supplied separately; normalization and rest-energy conventions are preserved without deriving equilibrium from units alone.
Newtonian and prescribed-static preparations preserve SI constant, mechanical momentum and observer-normalization conventions; the phase-action reference is separately specified.
Horizon-model adoption and Kerr–Newman conversion retain separate geometric and acceleration surface-gravity units and add their own field-equation and horizon hypotheses.
